name: The Deathstalkers
summary: Mennet Carkad tests hopeful Deathstalkers in the Undercity by sending them after a traveling messenger. Only the ruthless will find a place in Lord Varimathras's covert order.

sections.title: A Test in the Shadows
sections.body: In the Rogues' Quarter, Mennet Carkad sets a trial for anyone seeking a place among the Deathstalkers. They serve Varimathras as the Forsaken's secret police and elite assassins. A hopeful agent must show cunning and discretion, then prove the will to eliminate a target. Carkad means to turn away the weak and anyone troubled by too many scruples.

sections.title: The Interception
sections.body: Astor Hadren carries a letter along the road between the Undercity and Silverpine Forest. Carkad leaves the approach to you. To secure Hadren's personal introduction, you must intercept him and seize his credentials. Then the Deathstalkers can pass you off in his place to Andron.

faq.answer: The Deathstalkers are the Forsaken's covert order and elite branch for stealth and assassination. From the Rogues' Quarter in the Undercity, they gather intelligence and carry out espionage and covert executions. They report to Lord Varimathras.
Mennet Carkad is a Deathstalker handler in the Undercity's Rogues' Quarter. He oversees early trials and tests recruits hoping to join the covert ranks.

faq.q: Why does Mennet need Astor Hadren's letter?
faq.answer: Astor Hadren's letter of introduction lets a new operative take his place. The Deathstalkers can use it to deceive Andron.
Astor Hadren travels the road between the Undercity and Silverpine Forest, carrying correspondence for his contacts.

Lord Varimathras is a Nathrezim dreadlord who allied with Queen Sylvanas Windrunner to preserve his own existence. From the Royal Quarter, he oversees the Undercity's security, defense, and rogue operations.
Passing the trial proves an operative's competence. It leads to a covert impersonation assignment: deliver Astor's papers and infiltrate Andron's dealings.

angles.text: As a Forsaken rogue, joining the Deathstalkers brings you to the highest echelon of state service. There, streetwise scoundrels become sworn instruments of Varimathras and the Dark Lady.
As an undead, you see the Deathstalkers enforce Lordaeron's internal security with an iron grip. They watch for foes beyond the Forsaken and keep a wary eye on potential traitors within.

As a member of the Horde, you may not know how deeply the Deathstalkers operate in secrecy. They maintain vital intelligence networks while the Horde's southern allies remain largely unaware of the Forsaken's shadier domestic affairs.
